notes.title: TATSUJIN DLC release Hi Score Contest + Sale!
notes.content:

TATSUJIN! 
Shooting fans have likely heard the name before, but have you played Toaplan's influential shooter? Perhaps some of you know it by the name Truxton (trivia: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS_Truxtun_(CGN-35)]this[/url] was the reason behind that title).
Either way, this seminal title making a guest appearance in Game Tengoku can only mean one thing: hi-score contest time + celebratory sale!!
Brush up on your Tatsujin [url=https://gameparadise2017.com/manual/en/data/07_13.html]here![/url]

[b]How to participate[/b]
Simply play Time Attack's Stage 1 at any time during the contest and record a score online.
Only new or updated scores recorded during the contest will be valid, but multiple entries/characters are OK. 

[b]Rules[/b]
Duration: Feb 14th ~ 28th 11am (Japan time. Approx 13th 5pm ~ 27th 6pm PST)
Options: default settings only (scores only record with default options)
Character: Take your pick!
*prizes may vary depending on character used.
Prizes: No multiple winners. Should one person win multiple prizes, their highest score will be used to award a single prize.

[b]Prizes[/b]
TATSUJIN scores
[list][*][b]1st[/b]
Toaplan soundtrack CD (signed) + Jaleco flyer set 1&2
[*][b]2nd ~ 3rd[/b]
Jaleco flyer set 1&2
[*][b]Random:[/b]
Jaleco flyer set 1
[/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]
Non-TATSUJIN scores
[list][*][b]1st[/b]
Toaplan soundtrack CD (signed) + Jaleco flyer set 1&2
[*][b]2nd ~ 3rd[/b]
Jaleco flyer set 1&2
[*][b]Random:[/b]
Jaleco flyer set 1
[/list]

Here's a sample of the tracks courtesy of Clarice Disc:
https://youtu.be/v-e6oVzv4To

notes.title: Game Tengoku Ver1.08 update
notes.content:
Today's update includes:

[list][*][b]Fix for missing sound playback[/b]
This should enable those of you with Asus Xonar Essence STX II and similar cards to play with sound and fix sound related crashes too.
[*][b]Fixed Story Replay unlocks in Classic Mode [/b]
The 'Bonus' story should now unlock once all other Chapters have been unlocked.
[*][b]Fix to enable access to Sound Test menu[/b]
The menu will now be accessible, but to listen to DLC voice/music, you will need the DLC in your Steam library.
[*][b]Fix for Driving World's background[/b]
Some of the clouds were not displaying correctly; this should be fixed.
[*][b]Fix for UI display glitches[/b]
The bonus gauge and some other UI elements should now display correctly all the time.
[*][b]Other minor fixes[/b][/list]

As always, if you have any problems related to this release, please check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/663130/discussions/0/1488866813759788530/?ctp=5]this thread[/url] out or contact us via games@degica.com

Firstly, apologies for the prolonged wait without news (again!). 

[h1]Contest Update[/h1]
If you recall, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/663130/announcements/detail/1649875573511873471]we had an art contest at the end of 2017[/url] with the winner's illustration being enshrined in the the game as one of Clarice's bombs. notes.title: Localisation & international release update
notes.content:
Firstly, sorry for the lack of updates; we really wanted to have something to show you all rather than just our heartfelt apologies so you'll find some early test-shots of the subtitles in action during the Arrange Mode below.

But first, sorry everyone: the release has had to be pushed back until this spring. The development team is only small and they're hard at work updating the game, more [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791460136656/announcements/detail/2469524457503420537]DLC[/url] and on top of that, the need to go back into the original code and add subtitles timed to the on-screen action has been a lengthy process.

So, without further ado: here's the current screens from the PS4 version.
Each character has colour-coded subs and they can be switched on/off too.

notes.title: Clarice Bomber illustration contest results!
notes.content:
That's right, the results of the illustration contest we ran in December are in!
The first prize, if you recall, was that the winner's illustration would be immortalised in the game as a bomb for the DLC character Clarice ([url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/745910]released today![/url]).

So, without further ado, here's our grand prize winner:

[h1]1st Hirohiroki![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/4509984d0127533a539eed471d10ece5de5e3b93.jpg[/img]
A great rendition of Clarice and her beloved Claricecar being pursued by the police. Congratulations!

[h1]2nd Kanouchi[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/db7e3194d4f4ae86ea7fe79cf234a323957f2dfe.jpg[/img]
The mysterious, blonde (fake?!) Clarice, from "Gunbare! Game Tengoku", the sequel to Game Tengoku. Will her relationship with the 'true' Clarice ever be explained?! Excellent work!

[h1]3rd Jonathan[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30615248/c835b71fc7e9143efdfe00ddfa75db6dfee52534.jpg[/img]
Clarice as she would have appeared in Cannonball Run, perhaps? And her ever present Claricecar in tow. A great illustration with a well thought out catch-phrase too.

We'd like to thank everyone for their fantastic depictions of Clarice: the development team had a hard time choosing in the end!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745910

notes.title: Game Tengoku Ver1.03
notes.content:
We just released an update adding some common feature requests and also also fixing a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Game Tengoku developers interview
notes.content:
Famitsu Online published the first part of an interview with the development team recently. 

[h1]Interviewees[/h1]
Nobuhiro Yoshikawa - Producer & president of City Connection
Masahiro Arai - Chief game designer
Takanori Kazaana - Assistant game designer
Nozomu Akiyama - Main Programmer

https://www.famitsu.com/news/201709/04140830.html

[h1]Overview[/h1]
They talk about... [list]
[*]How CruisinMix came about
The team met up when City Connection were putting together the 3 disc soundtrack release for Game Tengoku
[*]Why the Saturn version was chosen over the arcade?
Yoshikawa-san wanted to do a Saturn port, but thought it would be impossible so asked about the arcade version. The team replied they could probably get the Saturn version working.
[*]The troubles involved with the port
Locating and recovering the master data and source code for the Saturn version was far from easy!
[*]The Claris DLC
A new character, added from scratch and recreated by the original Game Paradise designer, pixel by pixel.
[/list]
.. amongst other things.

Unfortunately, we can't offer a full translation, but hopefully, we'll be able to arrange an interview with them all nearer release!
